calls.statement:
SELECT DISTINCT EXTRACT(YEAR FROM join_date) AS join_year
FROM dim_member
WHERE is_current = TRUE
ORDER BY join_year DESC
LIMIT 10

SELECT DISTINCT fiscal_year, MIN(period_start_date) as fy_start, MAX(period_end_date) as fy_end
FROM ref_fiscal_calendar
WHERE fiscal_year IN ('FY2025/26', 'FY2024/25')
GROUP BY fiscal_year
ORDER BY fiscal_year DESC

-- Check member counts for calendar year 2025
SELECT 
  home_store_id,
  COUNT(*) as new_members
FROM dim_member
WHERE is_current = TRUE
  AND EXTRACT(YEAR FROM join_date) = 2025
GROUP BY home_store_id
ORDER BY home_store_id

-- Get new members by store for calendar year 2025 with store names
SELECT 
  m.home_store_id,
  COALESCE(s.store_name, 'Online') as store_name,
  COALESCE(s.format, 'Web') as format,
  COUNT(*) as new_members_2025
FROM dim_member m
LEFT JOIN dim_store s ON m.home_store_id = s.store_id AND s.is_current = TRUE
WHERE m.is_current = TRUE
  AND EXTRACT(YEAR FROM m.join_date) = 2025
GROUP BY m.home_store_id, COALESCE(s.store_name, 'Online'), COALESCE(s.format, 'Web')
ORDER BY new_members_2025 DESC

-- Verify the count of online sign-ups separately
SELECT COUNT(*) as online_signups_2025
FROM dim_member
WHERE is_current = TRUE
  AND home_store_id = 900
  AND EXTRACT(YEAR FROM join_date) = 2025

-- Final query: New members by store in 2025
SELECT 
  m.home_store_id as store_id,
  COALESCE(s.store_name, 'Tuomimetsä web shop') as store_name,
  COUNT(*) as new_members
FROM dim_member m
LEFT JOIN dim_store s ON m.home_store_id = s.store_id AND s.is_current = TRUE
WHERE m.is_current = TRUE
  AND EXTRACT(YEAR FROM m.join_date) = 2025
GROUP BY m.home_store_id, COALESCE(s.store_name, 'Tuomimetsä web shop')
ORDER BY new_members DESC, store_id
